deliverables_per_topic: topics/<slug>/brief.md: principle, accuracy guards, story beats, shot table
topics/<slug>/narration.txt: exact Piljae TTS text only
topics/<slug>/title-description.txt: 3 Shorts title options, description, hashtags, final script
topics/<slug>/topic.json: clips, draft timeline, caption keywords, topic guards
topics/<slug>/narration.en.txt: exact English TTS text only, one line per Korean sentence (only when en is enabled in language_sets.required)
topics/<slug>/title-description.en.txt: English title options, description, hashtags, final English script (only when en is enabled in language_sets.required)
outputs/<slug>-final.mp4, outputs/<slug>.srt, outputs/<slug>-verification.json (local only, not in Git)
outputs/<slug>-final-en.mp4, outputs/<slug>.en.srt (English set, same picture edit; local only, not in Git) (only when en is enabled in language_sets.required)

voice.voice_id_rule: always re-resolve from the authenticated /v3/voices catalog; never hard-code

length_budget.rule: measure final speech first; duration_target_seconds is draft; extend the picture to fit speech plus at least 1 s payoff tail, never speed up or trim speech
length_budget.estimate: about 6.2 Korean characters (spaces excluded) per raw second; measured: checkvalve 292 chars = 44.6 s, tower-crane 287 chars = 46.15 s; use the slower rate
length_budget.over_budget_rule: 2026-10-11 user: running a little long is fine; lengthen the video (e.g. 51 s) instead of cutting speech; still never speed up or trim speech

language_sets.rule: 2026-10-11 latest user request: Korean only for now (Piljae + Korean captions/titles); retain existing English assets/settings, skip new English drafting/generation/rendering unless en is explicitly re-enabled
language_sets.picture_master: ko: Blender keyframes and clip timelines follow the Korean Piljae timing.json; the English set reuses that picture unchanged

voice_en.character: smooth, calm, explanatory adult male English narrator (user 2026-10-11)
voice_en.voice_id_rule: resolve by English name from the authenticated /v3/voices catalog (original, ssfm-v30); never hard-code; list candidates with connect-typecast.ps1 -ListVoices -Gender male -UseCase 'E-learning/Explainer'

postprocess.sentence_placement: cut the English take at its sentence silences and start each English sentence at the matching Korean sentence start from work/<slug>/timing.json, so the shared picture stays in sync; a line that would run past the next Korean start may start earlier into the preceding pause (keep >= 0.35 s after the previous English line and >= 0.25 s before the next Korean start)

length_budget.rule: each English sentence (after rate) must end before the next Korean sentence starts; the last one must end at least payoff_tail_seconds_min before the video end; if not, shorten that English line and regenerate; never speed it up and never cut speech
length_budget.estimate: about 3.6 English syllables per raw second for a calm narrator

voice_en.writing_rule: original English adaptation of each Korean line, same facts and beat order; hook reaction word (e.g. 'insane') must land near the Korean punch-in cue

reference_structure: visible failed action with the hero object already moving
same object structure improves in view
a real remaining limitation is shown
satisfying contact and locking, with both before and after states visible
same assembly in practical use; name and summarize the principle
composition continuity at ending, never undo the physical result to force a loop
immersion_structure: visible failed action with the hero object already moving
same object structure improves in view
a real remaining limitation is shown
satisfying contact and locking, with both before and after states visible
same assembly in practical use; name and summarize the principle
composition continuity at ending, never undo the physical result to force a loop

principle_info: 0-5 s hook: flip a common belief or show a surprising fact + reaction word
the principle as 3-4 visible steps (a loop or sequence)
one-sentence summary that answers the question
final info: a surprising everyday consequence or tip that follows from the principle
problem_solution: visible failed action with the hero object already moving
same object structure improves in view
a real remaining limitation is shown
satisfying contact and locking, with both before and after states visible
same assembly in practical use; name and summarize the principle
composition continuity at ending, never undo the physical result to force a loop

style.look: reference-led warm realistic-shaded ink illustration; preserve gold/bronze/linen/limestone textures and continuous intact object motion, using storyboard-linked Higgsfield start/end images
style.priority: Preserve approved visual quality and meaningful motion while minimizing paid credits; 50 is a ceiling, never a spending target. Prefer exact local animation for mechanisms and only generate necessary character/action clips.
style.motion_rule: Every scene must contain continuous subject or process animation related to the explanation: walking, cart translation, rolling wheels, flowing water or a moving explanatory demonstration. Preserve rigid parts and object identities. During a measured result keep the result stable while real secondary motion continues. Never change a physical result just to make it lively.
style.scale_cues: use a scale cue only when useful; a small tabletop fastener needs no person silhouette
style.composition: one fixed headline block centered at x=540,y=260 (normally two lines, white then yellow); one caption block centered at x=540,y=1360; layout v6 is mandatory for every topic and enabled language

higgsfield_credit_policy.strategy: Use the fewest paid clips needed for the approved motion and style; reuse coherent assets, animate geometry locally, avoid paid audio/upscale/render and automatic retries.
higgsfield_credit_policy.user_revision: 2026-10-11: 50 is the maximum only; save as much as possible without losing the approved style.

layout.reason: 2026-10-11 user requested narration captions slightly lower and semantic line breaks; headline proportions from approved v5 remain.
layout.scope: all topics, new templates, Korean and every enabled language; existing finished media stay historical
layout.override_policy: MANDATORY: use this global layout even when old topic text mentions another version. Topic may supply words, line breaks and keywords only; never override coordinates, sizes, widths or safe zones without a newer explicit user request.
rules: MANDATORY for every new video: title block center (540,260), caption block center (540,1360) at 1080x1920; scale every coordinate and stroke proportionally for other 9:16 resolutions.
fixed headline is one block, normally two lines: first white, second yellow #FFD400; use topic title_fixed_lines when supplied, otherwise wrap the existing title without rewriting it.

title font 108 px (fit down to 84 only when needed), heavy Korean sans, slight italic shear 0.10, dark 14 px outline and soft shadow; complete ink including outline/shadow inside title band and max 87 percent width.
caption font 64 px, bold, max two lines and 74 percent width; one and two lines share the SAME block center y=1360; white with yellow topic keyword emphasis, 8 px outline and soft shadow.
text is fixed headline and speech captions only; no progress chips, step headings, part labels or caption/title background box, bar, panel or blurred plate.
full-bleed picture; never crop the scene into the action-focus rectangle; show the complete apparatus around the middle and avoid hiding measured surfaces behind text.
no text in top 90 px, bottom 440 px or right UI column; do not reuse the obsolete top-500-px mask because the user now explicitly approved a higher headline.
verify final ink bounds and UI overlap at 360 px width; reference screenshot proportions are production choices, not universal device safe-area specifications.

horizontal_centering.rule: center the actual rendered ink bbox of EACH title/caption line (including italic overhang and outline) at x=540; equal side margins
horizontal_centering.verify: start, middle, end, longest one-line and two-line captions; measure separate overlay masks

layout.phone_check: 360 px wide; text bounds [100,440] and [1230,1470]; masks top 90, bottom 440, right column; also inspect 9:19.5 and 9:20 display simulations. Keep approved layout rather than shifting text per scene.

title.mode: one fixed headline block for whole video; normally two lines

checks: title and caption block centers match normalized v6
actual ink within designated bands and max widths
no text overlaps UI masks or critical measurement surfaces

captions.timing_source: Whisper on final hosted Piljae audio
captions.style: white bold text with an 8 px dark outline and a soft drop shadow directly on the picture; no background box, bar, panel or blur plate; topic keywords in yellow
captions.vertical_anchor: one-line or two-line block centered at y=1360; ink, outline and shadow inside y=1230-1470
captions.shadow: soft drop shadow, 4 px offset, 60 percent black, 6 px blur
captions.on_screen_titles: layout v6 fixed headline block, max two lines (white first, yellow second), center y=260; no progress chips, step headings or part labels
captions.line_break_rule: Plan semantic phrase boundaries before rendering; do not split a word or detach a connective from its clause. Prefer balanced two lines at whitespace; never shrink the caption font. Split an overlong phrase into successive meaningful timed captions, preserving every authored word.

captions_en.timing_source: Whisper on final English narration audio
captions_en.style: same font size, outline, shadow and position as the Korean captions; no background panel; topic keywords (topic.json caption_keywords_en) in yellow
captions_en.on_screen_titles: layout v6 fixed headline block, max two lines (white first, yellow second), center y=260; no progress chips, step headings or part labels
captions_en.vertical_anchor: one-line or two-line block centered at y=1360; ink, outline and shadow inside y=1230-1470
captions_en.shadow: soft drop shadow, 4 px offset, 60 percent black, 6 px blur
captions_en.line_break_rule: Plan semantic phrase boundaries before rendering; do not split a word or detach a connective from its clause. Prefer balanced two lines at whitespace; never shrink the caption font. Split an overlong phrase into successive meaningful timed captions, preserving every authored word.

native_edit.audio_input: premixed Piljae plus quiet original sound design; Whisper uses the clean Piljae file

guards: resolve actual Piljae voice_id from authenticated API catalog
measure final speech before visual generation
show the current Higgsfield and Typecast cost and balance and get user approval before any paid generation
one approved mechanism asset reused across clips
no generated speech or baked text in raw clips
only enabled language sets receive captions and the fixed title in post; currently Korean only; no part labels
never retry an unknown submission automatically
original spoken text; never copy reference wording
explain the generic method; do not claim a specific project's numbers unless verified
never silently replace the chosen English narrator; show its cost and get approval before generation like Piljae

visual_clarity.reason: 2026-10-11 user: the tower crane 3D was still hard to read and too complex; simplify the picture so the mechanism is understood at a glance
visual_clarity.one_idea_per_shot: the part the narration is talking about is the biggest, brightest and only clearly moving thing in frame at that moment
visual_clarity.minimal_parts: model only parts needed to explain the principle; no repeated detail such as lattice, bolt rows, cables, hoses, pipes or site clutter unless that part is the principle

color_roles.water: clear medium blue, semi-transparent with a crisp level line
color_roles.hero_moving_object: one saturated accent (orange #FF7A1A) for the main moving object
color_roles.named_part_highlight: when narration first names a part, give it a soft yellow (#FFD400) rim glow for about 1.5 s, then return to normal
color_roles.background: soft sky-to-horizon gradient and a plain ground plane
color_roles.rule: one accent color per frame besides the yellow highlight; no other saturated colors

camera.main_view: one main 3/4 or side cross-section view that shows the whole mechanism; used for at least 60 percent of runtime
camera.screen_direction: keep the same left-to-right orientation for the whole video; never flip sides
camera.moves: slow eased moves only; return to the main view after every detail shot
camera.detail_shots: medium distance, at most 3 s each, never more than 1.15x scale change in a shot

visual_clarity.lighting: bright, even, soft shadows; no dark or high-contrast scenes; no fog, particles, lens flare or depth of field
visual_clarity.cutaways: hidden parts shown with a clean flat-colored cut plane; the cut stays in the same place all video
visual_clarity.arrows: at most two thick simple arrows on screen (water flow or force), same style every time
visual_clarity.generated_clips: Higgsfield uses approved reference/keyframes, generated illustration or Blender according to active topic; preserve the same look, colors, rigid objects and state sequence. No unexpected objects, people, text or clutter.
visual_clarity.style_frame_gate: Reuse the user-approved storyboard/style for an authorized continuation. For a newly proposed visual direction not already approved, show hook/main/key/ending style frames before full production.
visual_clarity.glance_test: downscale each style frame to 360 px wide grayscale; a viewer must be able to name the moving part within 1 second; write the one thing each frame should show and confirm it is the most visible element
visual_clarity.layout_authority: global layout v6 is mandatory; topic colors/style never change text proportions
visual_clarity.scope: baseline for engineering topics; the current approved topic reference determines illustration versus 3D, material textures and object palette. Global text layout cannot be overridden.
